headline: Kyrgyzstan to update the mechanism for providing tax benefits to investors
summary: Kyrgyzstan has developed a new mechanism for granting tax breaks to investors, and a draft cabinet resolution has been submitted for review.
why: Tax incentives shape how attractive a country is for foreign and domestic capital, which matters for investors assessing its business climate.
original_headline: В Кыргызстане обновят механизм предоставления налоговых льгот инвесторам
